categories.label: Bread
categories.note: Out of the oven by half seven

servings.label: How many people?
servings.help: Slices are generous. If you're between sizes, go up.

options.label: Fondant figures
options.note: Hand-modelled — four days' notice, 8 inch and up

products.name: Country Sourdough
products.subtitle: Naturally leavened, 48-hour ferment
products.description: The loaf we built the shop on. Flour, water, salt and a starter that's been going since the week we opened. Out of the oven at five and on the shelf by half seven — so if you want one on a Saturday, order it the night before.

products.name: Dark Rye & Seed
products.subtitle: Sunflower, pumpkin, caraway
products.description: Dense, dark and faintly sour. Keeps most of a week, which is just as well — very few people get through one in a day.

products.name: Baguette
products.subtitle: Thin, blistered, slightly scorched
products.description: Baked twice a day, at six and again at two, because a baguette is only really a baguette for about four hours.

products.name: Rosemary & Maldon Salt Focaccia, by the slab
products.subtitle: Olive oil, a lot of it
products.description: Proved slowly in the tray, dimpled by hand, and far oilier than is strictly sensible. Sold by the slab.

products.name: Butter Croissant
products.subtitle: Laminated with Ampersand butter
products.description: Three days from first fold to the counter. If you want one in the afternoon, order it in the morning.

products.name: Morning Pastry Box
products.subtitle: Six pastries, baker's choice
products.description: Whatever came out best that morning — usually two croissants, two pains au chocolat and two things we were experimenting with. The office-meeting order.

products.name: Sprinkle Doughnuts
products.subtitle: Raised, glazed, extremely bright
products.description: Not sophisticated and not trying to be. Friday to Sunday only, so they stay a treat.

products.name: Chocolate Chunk Cookies
products.subtitle: Brown butter, sea salt, 70% chocolate
products.description: The dough rests for 36 hours before it goes anywhere near an oven. It makes more difference than it sounds like it should.

products.name: Salted Oat Cookies
products.subtitle: Oats, dark chocolate, flaky salt
products.description: Chewier than the chunk cookie and a little less sweet. The one the regulars quietly prefer.

products.name: Birthday Cake
products.subtitle: Six layers, naturally coloured
products.description: The one we make most. Colour comes from beetroot, turmeric and butterfly pea rather than a bottle, so the shades are quieter than you might expect. Children never notice. Their parents always do.

products.name: Chocolate Celebration
products.subtitle: Dark chocolate ganache, piped and drizzled
products.description: For people who, asked what kind of cake they'd like, say "chocolate" and then stop talking.

products.name: Seasonal Berry
products.subtitle: Vanilla sponge under whatever fruit is in
products.description: Dressed with fruit from the market on Saturday morning, which is why it needs three days and why no two have ever matched.
